title: Fix release workflow fetch authentication so signed tags and attest notes can be fetched on GitHub-hosted runners
description: Fix release workflow fetch authentication so signed tags and attest notes can be fetched on GitHub-hosted runners
no_spec_change_rationale: This repairs CI authentication plumbing without changing the aps CLI contract or release artifact semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Release fetches use one checkout-managed credential, the release distribution contract rejects manual duplicate Authorization headers, and a v1.1.0 workflow dispatch passes provenance.
